name: Invoice Payment Reconciliation Status V 01
definition: The message InvoicePaymentReconciliationStatus is sent from a payee to a payer to acknowledge attribution of payments.|A payee that has received payment reconciliation information uses this message to confirm or to question common understanding of payments and instalments.|The payee may include references to the corresponding items of an InvoicePaymentReconciliationAdvice message or to other messages and may include the referenced data.|The message can carry digital signatures if required by context.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Specifies a set of characteristics that unambiguously identify the status, common parameters, documents and identifications.

ReconciliationCount.name: Reconciliation Count
ReconciliationCount.definition: Specifies the number of reconciliation lists.

ItemCount.name: Item Count
ItemCount.definition: Total number of individual items in all lists.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in all lists, irrespective of currencies or direction.
